description: This file defines the main component for the OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) monitoring page in a React application. It handles user input for a run ID, fetches OEE data from an API, and displays the OEE breakdown, including availability, performance, and quality metrics, along with loading, error, and empty states.

methods.name: pct
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a percentage string, handling non-finite values.

methods.name: Meter
methods.description: React component displaying a labeled meter with a progress bar.

methods.name: fetchOee
methods.description: Asynchronous function to fetch OEE data for the entered run ID, managing loading and error states.
